title: Managed Database: restore rate
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database restore rate is specified by contracted tier. Point-in-time restore processing; USD per restored GB.

| Contracted tier | Restore rate |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.018 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.018 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.018 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.018 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.018 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.018 |

## Tier comparison
For restore rate, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.018.
